facts.text: Jon expressed gratitude to Gina for her support and mentioned that opening the dance studio has been an inspiring experience, emphasizing the importance of creating a supportive environment for dancers.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina! It's been so inspiring to work with our young dancers, seeing their passion and commitment. Opening the dance studio's been a great experience - I want it to be a place of support and encouragement for all our dancers.

facts.text: Gina acknowledged Jon's efforts and emphasized that starting the studio is not just a business but a place for dancers to grow, asking about the specific support Jon is offering.

evidence.quote: Starting this studio isn't just a business, it's a place for dancers to grow. What support are you offering them?

facts.text: Jon stated that in addition to dance classes and workshops, he is offering one-on-one mentoring and training to help dancers reach their full potential.

evidence.quote: Besides the dance classes and workshops, I'm offering one-on-one mentoring and training to help dancers reach their full potential.

facts.text: Gina affirmed that Jon's one-on-one mentoring and training would help dancers achieve their goals, and she shared her own experience of having a mentor when she was learning to dance.

evidence.quote: Your one-on-one mentoring and training will really push dancers to reach their goals. I totally get it, I had a mentor too when I was learning how to dance.
